name: AH 3571
title: Health Hazards in the Workplace
description: Anticipation, recognition, evaluation, control, and communication of health hazards in the workplace.
requirement_description: Open only to BGS students and Allied Health Sciences-OEHS, Public Health and Health Promotion, Standard Plan, and Healthcare Admin concentration majors, juniors or higher, and OSH Certificate students; others with consent. Recommended preparation: AH 2001.
